availability-grid.$description: AvailabilityGrid. Component tokens reference SEMANTIC tokens through their CSS variables, so one declaration covers both themes. Every state has a non-colour cue: a selected slot carries a check mark on the quiet Qeet tint, an unavailable slot is hatched in a sunken well, and a free slot is the plain surface.

slot-height.$description: One time slot's height, a step under the density-resolved control height: 28px at default density (unchanged), 24px at compact — still the WCAG 2.2 minimum target — and 32px at comfortable.

slot-background.$description: A free slot: the plain surface.

selected-background.$description: A selected slot: the quiet Qeet tint rather than a solid fill, so a week of availability does not become a wall of orange. The check mark, not the tint, is what carries the state.

selected-indicator.$description: The check mark in a selected slot: brand text colour, ≥4.5:1 on the tint in both themes.

unavailable-background.$description: A booked or blocked slot: a sunken well under the hatch.

unavailable-pattern.$description: The hatch lines over an unavailable slot — the control boundary role, so the pattern clears 3:1 against its well in both themes: it is the state's only visual cue, so it is held to the non-text minimum. Redrawn in GrayText under forced colours.
